fix.no_space: Free up space in Library or move the download to another drive.
fix.exists: Restart with Overwrite, or remove the old file in Library.
fix.bad_release: Refresh the catalog in Settings and queue the game again.
fix.root_unavailable: Reconnect the drive, then press Resume.
fix.downloads_unavailable: Catalog browsing still works; queue on a supported firmware.
fix.source_changed: Use Restart from zero, or Change link to a mirror.
fix.provider_page: Open the page on the PS5 browser or on your phone, finish any check, then use Change link.
fix.hash_mismatch: Use Restart from zero. If it keeps failing, pick another release.
fix.drive_missing: Plug the drive back in — the download resumes from where it stopped.
fix.install_failed: Install it from XENO TOOL → Install, or with etaHEN.
fix.forbidden: The link may have expired — use Change link with a fresh one.
fix.not_found: The file was removed from the host — pick another release.
fix.rate_limited: Lower Connections in Settings or wait for the retry.
fix.transport: Nothing to do — XENO STORE retries with backoff.
